                                                          Corporate Governance Report
                                                                         企業管治報告


The Board believes that good corporate governance is an              董事會相信，良好的企業管治是提高現有及未來股
essential element in enhancing the confidence of current and         東、投資者、僱員、業務夥伴及整體社會信心的關
potential shareholders, investors, employees, business partners      鍵因素。在這方面，我們一直致力推廣及貫徹執行
and the community as a whole. To this end, we strive to promote      企業管治的最高標準。
and uphold the highest standard of corporate governance.


The Company has put in place corporate governance practices          本公司已實施企業管治常規，以遵照聯交所證券上
to comply with all the provisions and most of the recommended        市規則（「上市規則」）附錄14所載企業管治守則（「守
best practices of the Corporate Governance Code (the “Code”)         則」）的所有條文及大部分建議最佳應用守則，唯偏
as set out in Appendix 14 of the Rules Governing the Listing of      離守則條文第A.2.1條及A.6.7條者除外。
Securities on the Stock Exchange (the “Listing Rules”) except for
the deviation from the code provisions A.2.1 and A.6.7.


Code provision A.2.1 provides that the roles of chairman and chief   守則條文第 A.2.1 條規定，主席及行政總裁的角色
executive officer should be separate and should not be performed     應有區分，並不應由同一人同時兼任。王傳福先生
by the same individual. Mr. Wang Chuan-fu is the Chairman and        為本公司的主席兼行政總裁。董事會認為此架構不
Chief Executive Officer of the Company. The Board considers that     會影響董事會與管理層兩者之間的權利和職權的平

      2.1      BASIS OF PREPARATION                                              2.1   編製基準
               These financial statements have been prepared in                        此等財務報表乃按照由香港會計師公會（「香
               accordance with Hong Kong Financial Reporting Standards                 港會計師公會」）頒佈的《香港財務報告準則》
               (“HKFRSs”) (which include all Hong Kong Financial                       （「《香港財務報告準則》」）
                                                                                                    （包括所有《香港財
               Reporting Standards, Hong Kong Accounting Standards                     務報告準則》、《香港會計準則》
                                                                                                     （「《香港會計
               (“HKASs”) and Interpretations) issued by the Hong Kong                  準則》」）及詮釋）、香港公認會計原則及香港
               Institute of Certified Public Accountants (“HKICPA”),                   公司條例的披露規定而編製。此等財務報表
               accounting principles generally accepted in Hong Kong                   乃按照歷史成本法編製，惟若干以公允價值

      2.4      SUMMARY OF SIGNIFICANT ACCOUNTING                                     2.4   重要會計政策摘要
               POLICIES
               Investments in associates and joint ventures                                於聯營公司及合營公司的投資

               An associate is an entity in which the Group has a long-                    聯營公司是指本集團擁有一般不少於20%股
               term interest of generally not less than 20% of the equity                  份投票權之長期權益且本集團對其可行使重
               voting rights and over which it is in a position to exercise                大影響力的實體。重大影響力為參與投資對
               significant influence. Significant influence is the power to                象的財務及營運政策決策的權力，惟並非控
               participate in the financial and operating policy decisions                 制或共同控制該等政策。
               of the investee, but is not control or joint control over those
               policies.

      recognised for a provision is the present value at the end           報告期末預期需要清償責任的未來開支的現

      to be required to settle the obligation. The increase in the         中的融資成本內。
      discounted present value amount arising from the passage

     Leases – Estimating the incremental borrowing rate                    租賃 － 估計增量借貸利率

     The Group cannot readily determine the interest rate                  本集團無法立即釐定租賃中所隱含的利率，
     implicit in a lease, and therefore, it uses an incremental            故其使用增量借貸利率（「增量借貸利率」）計
     borrowing rate (“IBR”) to measure lease liabilities. The IBR          量租賃負債。增量借貸利率乃本集團為獲得
     is the rate of interest that the Group would have to pay to           與類似經濟環境中的使用權資產價值類似的
     borrow over a similar term, and with a similar security, the          資產所需借入的資金，而將須於類似期限內
     funds necessary to obtain an asset of a similar value to              以類似抵押品支付的利率。因此，增量借貸
     the right-of-use asset in a similar economic environment.             利率反映本集團「將須支付」的金額，當無
     The IBR therefore reflects what the Group “would have                 法獲得可觀察利率（例如就不進行融資交易
     to pay”, which requires estimation when no observable                 的附屬公司而言）或需要對其進行調整以反
     rates are available (such as for subsidiaries that do not             映租賃的條款及條件時（例如當租賃並非以
     enter into financing transactions) or when it needs to be             附屬公司的功能貨幣計值時），則需作出估
     adjusted to reflect the terms and conditions of the lease (for        計。本集團使用可觀察輸入數據（例如市場
     example, when leases are not in the subsidiary’s functional           利率（如可獲得）估計增量借貸利率，並須針
     currency). The Group estimates the IBR using observable               對不同實體作出若干估計（例如附屬公司的
     inputs (such as market interest rates) when available and is          單獨信貸評級）。
     required to make certain entity-specific estimates (such as

      Discount rate – The discount rate used is before tax and                       折現率 － 折現率乃未考慮稅務費用，並反映

      Raw materials price inflation – The basis used to determine                    原材料價格通脹 － 用作釐定原材料價格通賬
      the value assigned to raw materials price inflation is the                     的基準乃預算年度的預測物價指數。
      forecast price index during the budget year.


      The values assigned to key assumptions are consistent                          主要假設的價值與外界資料來源一致。
      with external information sources.

      recognises the income within one year upon receipt of

               assets (e.g., trade receivables) and projected cash flows                      日及來自經營業務的預期現金流量。
               from operations.


               The Group’s objective is to maintain a balance between                         本集團的目標為透過利用銀行借款、租賃負
               continuity of funding and flexibility through the use of                       債及公司債券以維持資金延續性及靈活性的
               bank borrowings, lease liabilities and corporate bonds.                        平衡。此外，本集團已安排銀行融資額以備
               In addition, banking facilities have been put in place for                     不時之需。除計息銀行及其他借款、租賃負
               contingency purposes. Except for the non-current portion of                    債及若干公司債券的非即期部分外，於報告
